what: FLAGSHIP-1 tie-breaks: switching cost, per-finger strain, corpus bootstrap
modeled_only: every number is a gauge/model output; tau saturated at 1.0, Phase-D cancelled — no claim about realized typing speed

switching_cost.reference: qwerty30m (C30M qwerty — a permutation of the same charset)
switching_cost.note: all-gauge-table.json has NO flagship-c3 row, so its switching_cost was never computed (trap 19). Recomputed here; the other seven are the positive control.

iweb.resample: multinomial on the shared-coverage trigram count vector, paired
iweb.sweep_note: N = trigram tokens resampled ~ characters typed. At full corpus mass every CI excludes zero, which is a statement about the MODEL's stability on that much text, NOT about a human. The user-scale rows are the readable ones.
